name: story-platform-monorepo
description: Monorepo Nền tảng Đọc & Nghe Truyện (Next.js Frontend + NestJS Backend)

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.type-check: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run type-check
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
